data.name: BATTLE GEAR
data.detailed_description:
Battle Gear is a single-player FPS that blends multiple genres, including zombies, comedy, linear storytelling, romance, and robot combat.

One day, a meteor crashes to Earth and is acquired by a U.S. pharmaceutical company known as “Rabbit Lab.”
As time passes, an unknown zombie outbreak begins within the facility, eventually sweeping across the United States.
With the government no longer functioning, survivors flee to the sea under the orders of the United Nations.

In response, the United Nations deploys you—humanity’s most powerful special agent—to the scene.
At the same time, they authorize the use of a secret weapon developed for the end of the world: “Battle Gear.”

The fate of the world is now in your hands.

Face the zombie threat and mysterious enemies seeking to reclaim the meteor that caused the disaster.
Use every means at your disposal to shape the future.

Game Progression

The game consists of 10 main stages and 3 side stages.

The main stages follow a story-driven progression over time.
Side stages also follow the same timeline but feature different gameplay styles in the form of mini-games.
They are optional and not required to understand the main story.

Key Features

  • Powerful and terrifying enemies

  • Unpredictable story progression

  • Rescue survivors, and some will fight alongside you

  • Human followers help you summon “Battle Gear,” the most powerful weapon only you can use

  • Experience the thrill of crushing enemies with followers and a wide arsenal of weapons

  • Enemy AI that is balanced—not too smart, not too dumb

  • Intense combat and the fun of discovering hidden followers

  • No advanced language skills required (the story is mostly told through visuals and cinematic scenes)

data.short_description: A zombie virus that began with a meteorite, the surviving humans fled to the sea by boat. To get the world back, And for the victory of the human race, Solve the problems, As a troubleshooter for the UN ,That's your mission.
